puddles.screen.title: Puddles Settings
puddles.command.wet: Puddles preview: %s%% wet. Use /puddles wet off to go back to the real weather.
puddles.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, no puddles are drawn and any that exist disappear.
puddles.option.style.tooltip: Water Blocks: whole blocks of real water on the block grid, in shapes of one to a few blocks, using the water texture. Pixel Puddles: chunky pixel-art puddles in many shapes and sizes.
puddles.option.fill.tooltip: How many seconds of steady rain it takes for every puddle to fill up. Light rain is slower.
puddles.option.dry.tooltip: How many seconds it takes for a full set of puddles to dry up once the rain has stopped. The small ones go first.
puddles.option.amount.tooltip: How many puddles form. Puddles gather in wet patches of ground, so even at 100% there are dry spots.
puddles.option.clarity.tooltip: How strongly puddles show against the ground. 100% is the normal look; lower is more see-through.
puddles.option.range.tooltip: How far from you puddles are drawn. Lower it if the game slows down.
puddles.option.ripples.tooltip: Rings that spread out on a puddle each time a raindrop lands.
puddles.option.splashes.tooltip: Splash particles, ripples and a soft sound when you or a mob walk through a puddle.
